effective_assignment: Construct exact or rigorously enclosed counterexample candidates over true unitary matrices and complex spectra, checking separation from all 24 hull points in a common direction.

new_result.theorem: At a permutation unitary, along U(t)=exp(tK), D(t)=v_id+t^2 sum_{i<j}|K_ij|^2(v_tauij-v_id)+O(t^3). Hence if v_id is the unique maximizer of a fixed support functional among the 24 permutation vertices, the determinant support has strictly negative Hessian in every nontrivial off-diagonal unitary tangent direction; monomial unitaries are strict local support maxima modulo diagonal phases.
new_result.exact_two_plane_case: If U mixes only coordinates i,j through an arbitrary 2x2 unitary block, D_U=alpha v_id+(1-alpha)v_tauij with alpha in [0,1]; a one-plane rotation stays exactly on a permitted hull segment.
new_result.effect: A generic strict-support MOC4 counterexample cannot be born by an arbitrarily small true-unitary perturbation of a uniquely exposed permutation vertex; any such failure must be a finite-distance multi-plane phenomenon.

exact_stress_candidate.properties: simple nonzero spectra, 24 distinct vertices, all 1x1 and 2x2 unitary minors nonzero, all 2x2 compression discriminants nonzero, no coordinate common reducing split
exact_stress_candidate.hull_certificate: exact nonnegative three-vertex Caratheodory representation verified with Fraction arithmetic
